resources.string: Android 16+. Request a glucose value in the system status chip.
Android 17+. Display glucose using the system metric template.

Independent of the floating overlay. These modes replace the notification chart with a system template. Enable both for MetricStyle with Live Update. The system controls promotion; without fresh data the normal notification returns.

Show the value in the notification title and the arrow in the metric field. Turn off to show value and arrow together as one metric. The system controls their actual sizes. With no arrow, the combined metric is used.
